meta.name: Bless the Harts
meta.description: BLESS THE HARTS es una comedia animada que sigue a los Harts, una familia siempre en quiebra y luchando por llegar a fin de mes. Esperan algún día lograr el sueño americano, pero ya son ricos -en amistades, familia y risas. Jenny Hart es una madre soltera que apoya a su familia trabajando como mesera en el pueblito de Greenwood, NC. Aunque Jenny es la jefa de familia, siempre está en desacuerdo o confabulando con su madre Betty, obsesionada por los billetes de lotería raspables, y su ingeniosa y creativa hija, Violet. El cariñoso y siempre optimista novio de Jenny desde hace 10 años, Wayne Edwards, es el amor de su vida y padre adoptivo de Violet. Es un soñador encantador que tal vez no haya triunfado, pero no se rendirá. Jenny tiene de su lado un poco de poder divino, ya que Jesús la visita regularmente mientras atiende mesas en el restaurante local, The Last Supper. Al final, los Harts tal vez no tengan mucho, pero probablemente tienen todo lo que necesitan.

videos.title: Hug N' Bugs
videos.overview: Jenny discovers a secret of Betty's that may help her pay overdue bills. Wayne is hurt when he discovers that Jenny's daughter Violet is featuring her biological father in her comics. Wayne tries to build Violet the tree house of her dreams.

videos.title: Can't Get There from Here
videos.overview: When money gets tight, Jenny takes on an undesirable second job to help fund Violet's art school tuition. Wayne comes up with an entirely different plan to make money.

videos.title: Jenny Unfiltered
videos.overview: When the town has split opinions over a controversial statue, Jenny learns to play both sides to appease her customers and make some extra money. Violet accompanies Betty to visit a blast from the past that does not go as planned.

videos.title: Cremains of the Day
videos.overview: When Violet, David and Leonard find out that Wayne is afraid of ghosts, they decide to take him on a ghost hunt to cure his fear. Meanwhile, Jenny and Betty try to honor Jenny's late father on his favorite holiday.

videos.title: Trash Twins
videos.overview: After Betty's arch-nemesis, Crystalynn, insults her and Jenny in public, the women conspire to get the ultimate revenge. Wayne tries to figure out how to deal with his misbehaving uncle.

videos.title: Pig Trouble in Little Greenpoint
videos.overview: Violet tries to deal with the moral dilemma of eating meat; Betty runs into an old fling.

videos.title: Myrtle Beach Memoirs
videos.overview: The Harts head to Myrtle Beach for a family vacation that they can't afford.

videos.title: Mega-Lo-Memories
videos.overview: The Harts want to continue their Thanksgiving tradition of Black Friday shopping instead of a meal.

videos.title: Miracle on Culpepper Slims Boulevard
videos.overview: When Louise invites the Harts and Brenda to her annual Christmas party in lieu of a bonus, the extravagance makes Jenny feel insecure; Betty tries to figure out how to give the family the best Christmas presents on a budget

videos.title: Tying the Not
videos.overview: In order to prove that she's not afraid of marriage, Jenny decides to take things to the next level with Wayne. Meanwhile, Betty attempts to expose Crystalynn as a liar after seeing her claim to have encountered a strangler on a popular crime show

videos.title: Violet's Secret
videos.overview: Jenny and Betty secretly follow Violet after becoming paranoid that she's making the same bad decisions they did as teenagers. Meanwhile, Wayne gets sued by Bobbie Nell.

videos.title: The Last Supper
videos.overview: A new restaurant leaves Greenpoint and the Last Supper in fear of financial ruin.

videos.title: My Best Frenda
videos.overview: When the Ladies of Greenpoint hire Jenny to help run their gala, Jenny's desire to fit in leads to a strain in her relationship with Brenda.

videos.title: Dead Mall
videos.overview: The Harts visit Greenpoint's abandoned mall, which brings back fond memories from the 2000s, but their reminiscing is interrupted when a mall rat named Stacey takes them hostage.

videos.title: Pound Pinchers
videos.overview: Jenny is faced with rowdy clientele when she becomes the night manager at The Last Supper.

videos.title: The McEntire Truth
videos.overview: When Marjune receives all the attention at a funeral by passing off a famous tale as her own life story, Betty and Crystalynn join forces to take her down.

videos.title: Mega Lo Memories: Part Deux
videos.overview: Betty, Jenny and Brenda reminisce over a past Black Friday memory while waiting in a Black Friday line.

videos.title: Pumped
videos.overview: Jenny and Betty get carried away with a string of questionable purchases after winning the lottery. Meanwhile, Wayne gets a job at his favorite hardware store.

videos.title: Invasion of the Potty Snatcher
videos.overview: Jenny goes to great lengths to show Louise that she deserves a raise without ever asking for one. Meanwhile, Betty takes Violet to her school conference and runs into a teacher she had a crush on.

videos.title: Crappy Death Day
videos.overview: A psychic tells Jenny she's cursed after attempting to get a refund for wrongly guessing Betty's death day. Meanwhile, Wayne's fishing trip with some wild work buddies turns into a manhunt for a dangerous species.

videos.title: Big Pimpin'
videos.overview: Jenny lets Louise use Wayne as a faux boyfriend after her husband tragically dies on a cruise ship. Meanwhile, Betty makes murder accusations while guest-starring on Violet's podcast.

videos.title: The Dogchurian Candidate
videos.overview: Jenny takes over as Mayor Webb's campaign manager for re-election against Betty and an accomplished dog. Meanwhile, Wayne tries to dig up dirt on the canine opponent.

videos.title: Trollin' With the Homies
videos.overview: Jenny and Wayne persuade Betty to get a job. Meanwhile, Violet and David's attempt to recruit a new friend backfires.

videos.title: Nose Bud
videos.overview: Jenny spends the weekend away at a wild bachelorette party with Brenda and leaves Wayne in charge of Violet. Meanwhile, Betty falls for the local strip club owner.

videos.title: Dance Dance Resolution
videos.overview: Jenny takes a mother/daughter bonding moment a little too far after Violet shows interest in learning to dance. Meanwhile, Wayne takes Betty to a flea market in hopes that she will finally give him the recognition he deserves.

videos.title: Easter's 11
videos.overview: When attendance at their local church begins to drop, the Harts plot to bring down the neighboring megachurch. Meanwhile, Violet tricks Wayne into helping her pull a prank that backfires.

videos.title: Hot Tub-tation
videos.overview: When Wayne gifts Jenny a hot tub for their anniversary, it proves to be more trouble than it's worth. Meanwhile, after getting banned from her favorite department store, Betty disguises herself in order to attend a sale.

videos.title: Hoot 'N Haw
videos.overview: When Wayne finds out he owns extra land, his family unexpectedly moves in on his property. Meanwhile, Violet searches for Wayne's "Uncle Tommy" after he goes missing.

videos.title: The Drincan Temple
videos.overview: When Wayne's non-committal best friend, Travis, comes to town, the two take on their dream of opening a bar together. Meanwhile, the Harts attempt to fix their broken car to preserve its sentimental value.

videos.title: When You Lose, You Win
videos.overview: When the Harts are stuck inside on Violet's rainy spring break, Jenny gets incredibly competitive about board games. Meanwhile, when trying to avoid her daughter's competitive streak, Betty gets a ride-along in a cop car.

videos.title: Haul Force One
videos.overview: When a massive heat wave hits Greenpoint, it stretches Jenny and Brenda's friendship to the breaking point. Meanwhile, Wayne gets a new truck and has issues letting go of his old one.

videos.title: Toni with an i
videos.overview: When Jenny ignores Jesus' advice on a moral conundrum, her new take on the truth causes huge problems in Louise's life. Meanwhile, both Betty and Wayne turn to Travis for spiritual healing after refusing to go to a doctor for help with medical problems.

videos.title: Tiny Pies
videos.overview: When the house across the street sells to a couple from New York, Jenny, Betty and Violet get caught in a lie trying to impress them. Meanwhile, Wayne and Travis try to become masters at cornhole in order to help Wayne's Mee-Maw.

videos.title: Betty's Birthday
videos.overview: With Betty's birthday coming up, the whole Hart family tries to figure out how old she is. Meanwhile, Wayne gets the family to take a trip in an RV he got for free.

videos.title: Bless the Harts Live Table Read | At Home with FOX
videos.overview: Creator Emily Spivey and executive producers Phil Lord & Chris Miller come together with the cast of Bless the Harts for a sneak peek table read of Season 2 episode "Crappy Death Day."
